<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from "vue";
import { cn, tagsInputClearVariants } from "@/lib/utils";
import { useTagsInputContext } from "./use-tags-input-context";
import type { HTMLAttributes } from "vue";

const props = defineProps<{ class?: HTMLAttributes["class"] }>();
const api = useTagsInputContext();
const clearProps = computed(() => api.value.getClearTriggerProps?.() ?? {});
</script>

<template>
  <button v-bind="clearProps" type="button" data-slot="tags-input-clear" :class="cn(tagsInputClearVariants(), props.class)">
    <slot>Clear</slot>
  </button>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from "vue";
import { cn, tagsInputInputVariants } from "@/lib/utils";
import { useTagsInputContext } from "./use-tags-input-context";
import type { HTMLAttributes } from "vue";

const props = defineProps<{ class?: HTMLAttributes["class"] }>();
const api = useTagsInputContext();
const inputProps = computed(() => api.value.getInputProps?.() ?? {});
</script>

<template>
  <input v-bind="inputProps" data-slot="tags-input-input" :class="cn(tagsInputInputVariants(), props.class)" />
</template>

import { computed } from 'vue'
import { tagsInputMachine, tagsInputConnect, type TagsInputApi, type TagsInputValueChangeDetails } from "@/lib/utils"
import { useMachine, normalizeProps } from '@zag-js/vue'

export type UseTagsInputProps = {
    id?: string
    value?: string[]
    defaultValue?: string[]
    inputValue?: string
    defaultInputValue?: string
    disabled?: boolean
    readOnly?: boolean
    invalid?: boolean
    max?: number
    allowOverflow?: boolean
    dir?: 'ltr' | 'rtl'
    onValueChange?: (details: TagsInputValueChangeDetails) => void
    onInputValueChange?: (details: { inputValue: string }) => void
    onHighlightChange?: (details: { highlightedValue: string | null }) => void
    onValueInvalid?: (details: { reason: string }) => void
}

export function useTagsInput(props: UseTagsInputProps) {
    const service = useMachine(tagsInputMachine, {
        id: props.id,
        value: props.value,
        defaultValue: props.defaultValue,
        inputValue: props.inputValue,
        defaultInputValue: props.defaultInputValue,
        disabled: props.disabled,
        readOnly: props.readOnly,
        invalid: props.invalid,
        max: props.max,
        allowOverflow: props.allowOverflow,
        dir: props.dir,
        onValueChange: props.onValueChange,
        onInputValueChange: props.onInputValueChange,
        onHighlightChange: props.onHighlightChange,
        onValueInvalid: props.onValueInvalid,
    })

    return computed(() => tagsInputConnect(service, normalizeProps))
}

<view class="{{className}}" data-disabled="{{disabled}}">
  <!-- Tags List -->
  <view class="tags-list">
    <view 
      wx:for="{{api.value}}" 
      wx:key="index"
      class="tag-item"
      data-index="{{index}}"
    >
      <text class="tag-text">{{item}}</text>
      <view 
        class="tag-delete" 
        data-index="{{index}}"
        bindtap="onDeleteTag"
      >×</view>
    </view>

    <!-- Input -->
    <input 
      wx:if="{{!api.isAtMax}}"
      class="tags-input"
      type="text"
      value="{{inputValue}}"
      placeholder="{{placeholder}}"
      disabled="{{disabled || readOnly}}"
      bindinput="onInput"
      bindconfirm="onConfirm"
    />
  </view>

  <!-- Max Indicator -->
  <text wx:if="{{max < 999}}" class="tags-count">
    {{api.value.length}} / {{max}}
  </text>
</view>
